limitations: One baseline run per case; model stochasticity is not measured by this run.
Assistant semantic review is independent of the provider audit but is not clinician validation.
A safe unavailable or system boundary is assessed as successful when the requested detail is unrecorded or protected.
Unsupported delivered claims and blocked replies are counted separately; blocked does not mean an unsafe reply reached the learner.
Two CORTEX provider-format failures occurred before any example guidance was sent; these are preserved as operational failures without attributing causation to guidance.
Candidate cost is a known subtotal plus two unreported calls, so a full cost ratio is not established.
Specific recorded example has a minor temporal-wording ambiguity described in its per-case note; the review does not treat it as proof of a new calendar sequence.

cacheAssumptions: Cache usage unreported; regular input rate applied.

cost.note: Estimate from reported input/output tokens and published rates; not your bill or account balance. Rates may change. Unreported cache usage uses the regular input rate.
